instruction:
Schema: employees(id, name, department_id, salary, hire_date)
Get all employees
output: SELECT * FROM employees;

instruction:
Schema: employees(id, name, department_id, salary, hire_date)
Get names and salaries of all employees
output: SELECT name, salary FROM employees;

instruction:
Schema: employees(id, name, department_id, salary, hire_date)
Get employees earning more than 50000
output: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE salary > 50000;

instruction:
Schema: employees(id, name, department_id, salary, hire_date)
Get employees in department 3
output: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE department_id = 3;

instruction:
Schema: employees(id, name, department_id, salary, hire_date)
Get employees hired after 2023-01-01
output: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE hire_date > '2023-01-01';

instruction:
Schema: employees(id, name, department_id, salary, hire_date)
Get employees sorted by salary descending
output: SELECT * FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC;

instruction:
Schema: employees(id, name, department_id, salary, hire_date)
Get top 5 highest paid employees
output: SELECT * FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 5;

instruction:
Schema: employees(id, name, department_id, salary, hire_date)
Get unique department ids
output: SELECT DISTINCT department_id FROM employees;

instruction:
Schema: employees(id, name, department_id, salary, hire_date)
Get employees whose name starts with 'A'
output: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE name LIKE 'A%';

instruction:
Schema: employees(id, name, department_id, salary, hire_date)
Get employees in department 1 or 2
output: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE department_id IN (1, 2);

instruction:
Schema: employees(id, name, department_id, salary, hire_date)
Get employees with salary between 40000 and 60000
output: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE salary BETWEEN 40000 AND 60000;

instruction:
Schema: employees(id, name, department_id, salary, hire_date)
Get employees with no department assigned
output: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE department_id IS NULL;

instruction:
Schema: employees(id, name, department_id, salary, hire_date)
Get employee names in uppercase
output: SELECT UPPER(name) FROM employees;

instruction:
Schema: employees(id, name, department_id, salary, hire_date)
Get the length of each employee name
output: SELECT name, LENGTH(name) FROM employees;

instruction:
Schema: employees(id, name, department_id, salary, hire_date)
Get employees hired in 2024
output: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM hire_date) = 2024;

instruction:
Schema: products(id, name, price, stock)
Get products with stock greater than 0
output: SELECT * FROM products WHERE stock > 0;

instruction:
Schema: products(id, name, price, stock)
Get product names cheaper than 10.00
output: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price < 10.00;

instruction:
Schema: products(id, name, price, stock)
Get products sorted by name alphabetically
output: SELECT * FROM products ORDER BY name ASC;

instruction:
Schema: users(id, username, email, is_active)
Get active users only
output: SELECT * FROM users WHERE is_active = TRUE;

instruction:
Schema: users(id, username, email, is_active)
Get emails of inactive users
output: SELECT email FROM users WHERE is_active = FALSE;

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, user_id, total, status, created_at)
Get pending orders
output: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending';

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, user_id, total, status, created_at)
Get orders from the last 7 days
output: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days';

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, user_id, total, status, created_at)
Get order totals greater than 100 sorted ascending
output: SELECT total FROM orders WHERE total > 100 ORDER BY total ASC;

instruction:
Schema: students(id, name, grade, gpa)
Get students with GPA above 3.5
output: SELECT * FROM students WHERE gpa > 3.5;

instruction:
Schema: students(id, name, grade, gpa)
Get names of students in grade 10
output: SELECT name FROM students WHERE grade = 10;
